key_features: SCHOOL SUPPLIES KIT: One 66-piece back to school school supplies kit that bundles writing, coloring, correction, and desk tools in a single prepacked box.
FOR STUDENTS AND PROGRAMS: The kit is great for back-to-school prep, classroom restocks, donation drives, and supply programs.

KIT CONTENTS: The kit includes 12 #2 pencils, 12 colored pencils, 0.7 mm mechanical pencil leads (3-pack), retractable oil-gel pens (3-pack), fineliner pens (4-pack), oil-gel grip pens (3-pack), fine-tip permanent markers (5-pack), chisel-tip dry-erase markers (4-pack), double-tip highlighters (6-pack), a 12 in ruler, a dual-blade sharpener, jumbo correction tape, 4 oz white glue, glue sticks (2-pack), and pink erasers (4-pack).
PER RETAIL UNIT: Each retail unit is one back to school school supplies kit with 15 school supply items and 66 total pieces.
ONE BOX, LIST COVERED: The prepacked kit replaces a cart of single items, covering supply lists in one purchase.
